work.editionBoundary: Actual official mixed-edition excerpts. Chapter 1 explicitly second edition; chapter-2 sample explicitly third edition, ©2019; chapter 14 official NVC3 file. No unified printing collated.

reading.countMethod: Manual semantic reading of all effective embedded pairs and all six ordered RU/EN routes; extraction and exact comparison used to bind canonical JSON to that same text.
reading.scopeCaution: Reading extracted effective corpus and inspecting renderer does not independently reproduce visual/runtime behavior.

modesRead.semanticAssessment: Coherent selected-method arc; no dependency on deeper-only cases. No material RU/EN mismatch found in these 16 pairs.
Ten additions provide cases and distinctions without a continuity break. NVC-01 changes RU meaning; NVC-02 misidentifies the taxi interlocutor.
Four further screens add substantive detail and the author's practice examples. Both findings persist; no additional defect or misleading essential omission found.

exactCopy.ru: Разбирая наказание, Розенберг предлагает два вопроса: что мы хотим, чтобы человек сделал, и почему хотим, чтобы он это сделал?
exactCopy.en: Rosenberg asks two questions about punishment: what do we want the person to do, and what do we want their reason for doing it to be?

findings.defect: RU asks why the speaker wants the act, losing the actor's motive. EN correctly preserves it.

ru.old: и почему хотим, чтобы он это сделал?
ru.new: и чем мы хотим, чтобы он при этом руководствовался?
